svg.title: Where every failed order event goes
svg.text: Where every failed order event goes
Each hop retries on its own terms, then parks what it cannot process. Nothing is dropped silently, and nothing blocks the orders behind it forever.
Records for one item stay in order, so a stuck record holds
back that shard: cap the retries.
Retry policy: up to 185 attempts over 24 hours (defaults),
for events that are useless when late.
Message reappears after the visibility timeout (set it to
FULL. Catch routes business errors to compensation
and everything else to a parked state.
Two rules that save the most pain: keep the DLQ retention longer than the source queue (14 days is the maximum), and alarm on any message in any DLQ.
A DLQ nobody watches is just a slower way to lose orders.
